display.title: Matzliach and the Mitzvah of Negel Vasser, Part 4
display.summary_short: In the robbers' cave Matzliach frees the caravan chief and a captive prince, then plans the robbers' capture. He returns home with royal gifts, saved by negel vasser.
display.summary_long: Inside the cave, Matzliach finds two prisoners tied to the wall: the caravan chief and a young man who looks like royalty. The chief tells him that after he left, the robbers attacked the caravan and killed everyone else, and Matzliach realizes that the merit of his mesiras nefesh for negel vasser saved his life. He cuts their ropes, and the young man explains that he is a sheikh's only son, captured after his soldiers were killed, and held for a huge ransom and a forced marriage to his sister. Matzliach insists on ending the robbers' terror, and when the grateful sheikh offers him his daughter and half his kingdom, he explains that he is a Jew with a family waiting at home. His plan: soldiers hide by the cave, wait for the robbers to return, and capture them one by one at the narrow entrance. Escorted home with royal gifts, Matzliach tells his family how negel vasser saved him and made him rich, only a tiny part of the reward that awaits in Olam Haba.
display.lesson: The merit of negel vasser, kept with mesiras nefesh, saved Matzliach's life; every mitzvah is precious beyond measure.

advisories.note: Robbers attack a caravan and the prince's soldiers; threats to behead a captive; a plan to smoke the robbers out.
